# Portfonia

> Portfonia provides a personal data API for a user's own AI agent: reports, complete daily holding snapshots, technical position, holding-related intelligence and strict current-holdings management. Access uses personal API tokens and subscription entitlements. Portfonia provides information and context, not investment advice.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://portfonia.com/agent.md): Authentication, endpoints, response schemas, limits and data handling.
- [Human guide and token settings](https://portfonia.com/agent): Getting started and personal token management.

## Access by plan

| Capability | No subscription | Basic (Weekly / Mon-Wed-Fri) | Advanced (Daily) | Jade |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Token metadata, available reports, account, calendar | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Subscribe or change plan from credits | Holdings-write token | Holdings-write token | Holdings-write token | Holdings-write token |
| Daily snapshots | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Intelligence | No | Macro headlines | Holding and macro headlines | Full detail |
| Current holdings, validation and change history | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Current-holdings writes | No | Holdings-write token | Holdings-write token | Holdings-write token |
| Technical position and series | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Five Jade risk tools | No | No | No | Yes |

An active subscription has `subscription_status == "active"` and a recognized
plan type. Row caps remain Basic 30, Advanced 50 and Jade 100, including cash
and watched rows. All existing rate limits and quiet windows apply.

## Onboarding a new user

1. If you operate the user's signed-in browser, create a personal API token at https://portfonia.com/agent. Choose holdings-write permission if you will subscribe or edit holdings. Otherwise, ask the user for a token.
2. Call `GET /agent/v1/token`, then `GET /agent/v1/account` to read capabilities, the current subscription, balance and plan fees in credits per month.
3. Without an active subscription, explain which features need one, for example: "I can manage your holdings once you subscribe." Tell the user the plans, their prices and the user's balance. Call `POST /agent/v1/subscription` only on the user's instruction. If the balance is short, give the account response's `top_up_url` (https://portfonia.com/profile).
4. The investment questionnaire may be skipped and answered later at https://portfonia.com/questionnaire.
5. After subscribing, call `GET /agent/v1/holdings`. If the book is empty, remind the user to enter current holdings and offer to do it with the holdings endpoints.

## Account, subscription and calendar

- `GET /agent/v1/account`: any personal token, no subscription required; current subscription, cash/gift/total balance, four plans with user-specific fees and capability codes, and the web top-up URL.
- `POST /agent/v1/subscription` with `{"type":"weekly"}` (or `mwf`, `daily`, `jade`): holdings-write token, no existing subscription required; subscribe or change plan using credits under the same rules as web Profile. Returns the updated account. Top-up stays on the web.
- `GET /agent/v1/calendar?start=&end=`: any personal token, no subscription required; US FRED/FOMC releases and earnings for the caller's holdings, including mapped leveraged-product underlyings. ET start defaults to today and end to start + 14 days; at most 31 inclusive days. Dates are scheduled dates, not forecasts.

These three endpoints send no data or modification notice. Consult agent.md for requests, responses and errors.

## Token permissions and change history

- `GET /agent/v1/token`: token metadata and current capabilities, with normal read limits and no data notice.
- `GET /agent/v1/holdings/changes?start=&end=`: any active subscription, either permission, inclusive ET dates within the last 30 days, at most 100 groups newest first and a truncated flag. Field-level changes are stored encrypted for 30 days.

## Technical position

- `GET /agent/v1/technical`: active Advanced or Jade, either token permission; optional ET date for a current or historical holdings table.
- `GET /agent/v1/technical/series`: active Advanced or Jade, either permission; required ticker, optional start/end ET dates, at most 92 inclusive days. End defaults to today and start to 91 days earlier.

Normal Agent limits apply. These endpoints send no access notice and compute descriptive metrics on demand from stored closes, without collecting data.

## Jade risk results

- [Jade risk results contract](https://portfonia.com/agent.md#jade-risk-results-jade): Active Jade, either token permission; five GET tools (replay, tail-risk, stress, style, tracking), unchanged web models and complete series; stress requires one scenario per request.

## Current holdings management

- [Current holdings contract](https://portfonia.com/agent.md#current-holdings-all-active-plans): Any active subscriber can GET current holdings and validate complete replacement, creation, single replacement or PATCH with either token permission. POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE changes require holdings-write permission. Stable IDs, decimal strings, explicit deletions and current versions apply; empty books and last-row Agent deletion are rejected. Only POST creation requires an idempotency key; a retry within 24 hours returns the original result. Every successful mutation increments the version once, including unchanged writes.

Stored-row limits are Basic 30, active Advanced 50, active Jade 100, counting cash and watches. Single-row writes share 30/minute and 100/hour; other calls keep the existing counters. The five Jade routes additionally share one request per 3 minutes and at most 10 per hour per user; existing burst, per-route limits and quiet windows also apply. Current holdings, change history, snapshot and Jade reads share the daily access notice; every successful Agent holdings write request may trigger a separate daily modification notice. Revocation stops future access without undoing changes. Request audit records metadata only; POST replay results are stored encrypted; retries within 24 hours return the original result.

Discovery includes this file, agent.md and the Agent-only OpenAPI schema: https://api.portfonia.com/agent/openapi.json. Do not call planned routes or the disabled full production openapi.json.

## Guides

- [Jade guides index](https://portfonia.com/guides): Public explanations of all six Jade portfolio tools.
- [Historical stress scenarios guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-stress): A historical shock, peak-relative paths and asset-class contributions.
- [Style exposure guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-style): Returns-based style weights, fit and their interpretation.
- [Rebalance and what-if guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-what-if): Current holdings, two user-edited versions and calendar rebalancing over historical prices; separate replay and stress anchoring, hindsight and cost limitations.
- [Tracking error guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-tracking): Excess return and variability against daily constant reference weights.

- [Holdings replay guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-replay): Unchanged quantities, total return, metrics, proxies and historical currency conversion through a fixed example.
- [Tail risk (VaR / CVaR) guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-var): Historical loss boundaries, tail averages, overlapping monthly windows and the questionnaire reference through a fixed example.
